explain.text: Wind favoured cold water for most of the past 47 hours, but it has swung back onshore in the last 12 hours. Under PierBite's wind model, a recent shift like that can push cold water away from the pier before it arrives, so the score is held down. The last reading from this sensor is 26.4 hours old.
